title: Pip and the Jog
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds j, v, w
note_for_grown_ups: This closes the set on the same note as Nell's Race: finishing first matters less than staying with a friend who needs you.

pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling sitting side by side at the start of a path by the hedge, ready to race.

pages.text: Will Pip win? Will Ned win?
pages.illustration: Pip and Ned both poised, eyeing the finish point further down the path.

pages.text: Pip did jog. Ned did jog.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Ned the duckling both racing along the path side by side.
Ned the duckling slipping sideways into a muddy puddle on the path, splashing.
Pip the sparrow continuing on along the path without stopping, glancing back briefly.

pages.text: Pip ran on. Pip did win!
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow reaching the end of the path first, wings spread in triumph.

pages.text: Ned is wet. Ned is sad.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling climbing out of the muddy puddle, dripping and glum, far behind.

pages.text: Pip ran back to Ned. Pip and Ned sat.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow sitting beside Ned the duckling by the muddy puddle, the two friends together.
